page: Microsoft Azure D64nlds_v6 is a network-optimized virtual machine from the Dnldv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel x86_64 processor. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a low memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. It includes 3780 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage. No GPUs are present on this instance.

Designed for network-intensive operations, the D64nlds_v6 balances high compute density with a streamlined memory footprint. The low memory-to-vCPU ratio provides a cost-efficient hardware profile for workloads that require substantial processing power and local storage throughput without the expense of excess RAM. The local NVMe SSD storage offers high-speed read and write capabilities directly on the host.

This server is suited for network-optimized applications, high-throughput web serving, distributed compute tasks, and database workloads that benefit from fast local NVMe storage but do not demand large memory capacities.
